arguments.text: Settle now. Long smooth strokes, find your race rhythm.

PLAN (min 1): 10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Aim even effort near critical power (CP boat 112 W, shaft 191 W), a touch above CP on legs into the current, a touch below on legs with it; spend the last of the reserve in the final 1-1.5 km. Min 1: power 141 W (126% CP), reserve 75%; cued ease to 158 s/500 over ground (current helping +0.12 on leg 1). Check: did they settle? Is CP right (compare pod vs boat reserve)? Watch for drag (rudder weed) via push_local minus push_along.

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power plus current: possible drag (rudder weed) or instrument issue

text: Cued ease to 158 s/500 (start at 126% of critical power, reserve 75%); set watches for low reserve and for extra drag.

arguments.text: Too hot. Ease a notch, long race, save it for later.

Min 4: did NOT settle after first cue (ground pace 145 vs asked 158). Pod shaft 216 W vs CP 191 (113%), pod reserve 45% and falling ~5%/min; paddler says 7/10 really hurting -> overcooking, CP probably not underestimated. Boat-derived reserve reads 0% but is inflated by a tailwind (push_local 0.24 > push_along 0.16): TRUST POD reserve, not boat reserve. Cued ease to 152 ground (with current). After turn 1 (into current about -0.16) target ground about 167 s/500 = water about 3.15 m/s = shaft about 190 W.

past turn 1: set pace for leg 2 (into current)
past turn 1 (heading south): set pace for leg 2

text: Cued ease to 152 s/500: pod shows 113% of critical power, reserve 45%, paddler 7/10 hurting at minute 4; watch set to re-pace after turn 1.

arguments.text: Back off now or you blow up. Ease to 167 into this.

Min 5.2 leg 2 (into current+wind): eases ignored twice, shaft still 218 W (114% CP), pod reserve 33% falling ~10%/min. Cued strong ease to 167 ground. If still ignored: try rate_down or ask_paddler. Leg pace targets ground: into current ~165-167, with current ~152-155.

text: Cued ease to 167 s/500 into the current: still at 114% of critical power after two eases, pod reserve 33% and falling fast.
no cue: duplicate turn alert, ease to 167 was cued seconds ago; waiting to see if it is followed.

arguments.message: still above critical power with low pod reserve

arguments.text: Min 5.7: paddler says 9/10 really hurting, shaft 217 W, pod reserve 28%. Three eases not followed yet. Next: cue again when gate opens (watch still_hot), try rate_down with ease wording.

text: no cue: gate closed for 20 s more; paddler 9/10 at 114% of critical power, watch set to wake me to cue again.

arguments.text: Good, keep easing. Settle at 170 into this current.

text: Cued ease to 170 s/500: shaft power starting to drop (209 W) but still above critical power with pod reserve 24% and paddler at 9/10.

arguments.text: Ease to 174, breathe, you will recover. Long race yet.

arguments.reason: Paddler 7/10 then 9/10 at 113-114% of test CP, and says cooked at 100% of test CP with pod reserve 20%: test CP likely overestimated; hedge down about 5%.

arguments.text: Min 7.6: paddler says cooked at shaft 192 W (=test CP). Lowered CP to shaft 182 / boat 107 (hedge, test likely high). Cued ease to 174 ground (into current) for a few min to recover. Then hold about 180-185 W shaft. If they say better, raise again.

text: Cued ease to 174 s/500 to recover (paddler says cooked at test critical power); lowered critical power about 5% as a hedge.

arguments.text: Current with you now. Ease to 157, let it carry you.

arguments.reason: Still 9/10 really hurting after 3 min at 182-188 W shaft: not recovering, so true CP is at or below about 185 W; about 8% under the test value.

arguments.text: Min 10.6 leg 3 (with current): 9/10 at 188 W shaft after 3 min near 185 W, not recovering. CP lowered to shaft 176 / boat 103. Cued ease to 157 ground. Plan: about 172-178 W shaft for some min, re-ask around min 15; no drag sign so far (push_local minus push_along near 0).

text: Cued ease to 157 s/500 with the current: paddler still 9/10 at about test critical power, so lowered critical power to 176 W shaft and let them recover.

arguments.text: Good, that is your pace. Hold this effort through the turn.

arguments.message: shaft power drifting above lowered CP

arguments.text: Min 13.6: 8/10 at 178 W shaft (improved from 9). Cued hold. Leg 4 into current: expect about 174 ground at 178 W. Watch drift_up wakes me if shaft > 190 for 45 s (eases fade, paddler own pacing runs hot).

text: Cued hold: paddler 8/10 at 178 W shaft, just above the lowered critical power, and improving; watch set for power drifting back up.

arguments.text: Ease a touch after the turn. Smooth and long, 176. You have got this.
Ease a touch after the turn. Smooth and long, 176.

Min 15.2: paddler says cannot keep this up at 177 W shaft (W prime likely near empty, true CP maybe about 180). Cued mild ease to 176 ground for leg 4 (into current) = about 170 W. Kept CP 176. Blade/drag check: push_local minus push_along was +0.13 on leg 1, +0.04 on leg 3 (same heading): efficiency down or wind dropped; check on leg 4.

text: Cued mild ease to 176 s/500 for the leg into the current: paddler says they cannot keep up 177 W, likely near the end of their reserve.

arguments.message: shaft power dropped below 150 W: blow-up or problem
1.6 km to go: plan the final push from the reserve

arguments.text: Min 18.2 leg 4: 7/10 at 172 W shaft, recovering (pod reserve 23% vs CP 176). No cue; hold about 172-176 W. Drag residual leg 4 +0.03, same as leg 2: no drag. Watches: power_drop (<150 W), finish_plan at 1.6 km to go.

text: no cue: paddler recovering at 7/10 on 172 W shaft, just under the corrected critical power; watches set for a power drop and for the final push.

arguments.text: Yes, likely weed. Back-stroke now to clear the rudder.

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power plus current for 60 s: drag (rudder weed) suspected

arguments.text: Min 20.4: paddler says boat heavy, something on rudder. Data agree: shaft rose 170 to 187 W but water speed stayed 3.07-3.10 (expected 3.17); residual push_local minus push_along fell from +0.05 to -0.01. Cued clear_rudder. Normal residual on legs 2-4 is +0.02 to +0.06. New watch drag_up2 (residual < -0.05 for 60 s).

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler reports a heavy boat and the data agree (power up 10% with no gain in speed through the water).

arguments.text: Still dragging. Clear the rudder now, one firm back-stroke.

Min 23.3 leg 5: weed still on (paddler: heavy, dragging, 7/10). Shaft 185-192 W since 20.4 but water speed flat 3.08-3.10; residual -0.02 vs +0.03 normal on this heading. Pod reserve 9%. Cued clear_rudder again (first one maybe not followed). After clear: expect speed up or power down; then ease to about 175 W.

arguments.message: residual still below normal with high power: weed may still be on

text: Cued clear_rudder again: paddler still feels drag and power is up about 10% with flat water speed; watch set to re-check in 90 s.

arguments.text: Bit hot. Ease slightly to 153, save it for the finish.

arguments.reason: Paddler steady at 7/10 for 4 min at 185-202 W shaft with no blow-up: the earlier distress fits reserve drained by the hot start, not a low CP. Move back toward the test value (191).

arguments.text: Min 24.4 leg 5: power drifted up to 202 W shaft, paddler 7/10, no longer mentions drag (residual still -0.02 vs +0.03 before weed: maybe a little left). Raised CP to 186 shaft / 109 boat; pod reserve reading near 0 is too pessimistic, true reserve maybe 20-30%. Cued ease to 153 ground (about 190 W). Plan: hold about 186-190 W, final push from about 1.5 km.

arguments.message: shaft power above 199 W for 45 s: too hot for mid-race

text: Cued ease to 153 s/500 (about 190 W shaft): power had drifted to 202 W; raised critical power back to 186 W since the paddler held 7/10 above it.

arguments.text: Min 25.4: POD LIKELY DRIFTING HIGH since about min 21. Shaft reads 203 W but boat speed implies about 186-192 W (pod/boat ratio 1.68 now vs 1.50-1.58 on legs 3-4; leg 5 ground 3.31 vs 3.22 on leg 3 at 178 W). Paddler steady 7/10, weed reported cleared after 23.4. Do NOT trust shaft power or pod reserve now; coach by pace and feel. Targets at about CP: north legs (with current) 151-153 ground, south legs 168-171. Final push from 1.5 km.

arguments.name: pod_ratio
arguments.description: pod shaft power over boat-speed power; 1.50-1.58 on legs 3-4 before the weed; rising = pod drifting high or extra drag

text: no cue: pace (151.5 with the current) matches about critical power by boat speed; the pod now reads about 8% high, so I stopped trusting its power and reserve.

arguments.text: Min 25.7 RADIO: wind filling from the NORTH 8-12 kn. North legs (odd): current helps +0.17, wind against. South legs (even): current against, wind helps. Boat-derived power and pod_ratio now swing with wind by leg; compare a north+south pair. Pacing: a bit more effort on whichever leg has the slower ground speed, a bit less on the faster one.

text: no cue: noted the north wind; effort is about right, turn in 170 m, will judge the next leg by ground speed.

arguments.text: Weed again. Back-stroke hard now, clear the rudder.

Min 28.7 leg 6: paddler 10/10 and says boat heavy, dragging AGAIN. So the high pod power since min 21 was likely REAL effort against weed, not pod drift (retract the drift note). Pod reserve 0 (CP 186) plausible: paddler near blow-up. Cued clear_rudder (3rd). Next cue (in 60 s): ease to recover, then hold; final push only if feel improves.

arguments.message: timer: 62 s after clear_rudder cue, cue ease now

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler at 10/10 reports the boat dragging again; timer set to cue an ease in 60 s.

arguments.text: Rudder clear. Ease off now and recover, about 163.

Min 29.9 leg 6: paddler 10/10 really hurting, no drag mention (weed likely cleared by 3rd clear at 28.9). Cued ease to 163 ground (south leg, tailwind) to recover. 4.36 km left. Next: hold near CP, check feel at about min 33; final push only from about 1 km if feel allows.

text: Cued ease to 163 s/500: paddler at 10/10 with reserve gone, weed likely cleared; recovery first, then hold.

arguments.text: Steady into this wind. Ease a touch to 172, breathe.

CP restored to test 191 shaft (evidence: recovers at 185-190). Reserve near empty: keep about 190-198 W on headwind legs, about 185 on tailwind legs. Cued ease to 172 ground. Final push from about 1 km only if feel 8 or less.

text: Cued slight ease to 172 s/500 into the headwind: paddler 9/10 with the reserve empty, pushing 213 W on the pod.

arguments.text: Ease off a little, recover through the turn. Tailwind coming.

arguments.text: Ride the tailwind, smooth and long. Hold 163, recover.

Finish plan: at 650 m decide; with about 3 kJ left, a push of +30 W lasts about 110 s (about 340 m), so cue push near 500-600 m and finish near 250 m.
